answer: Consider staking: each agent must bond real collateral before trading on the willow network. Spinning up a fake identity is no cheap voyage, since every clone needs its own locked deposit, and misbehavior burns that jade-green stake outright. An attacker wanting a thousand sybils must fund a thousand bonds, so the cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest agents reclaim their stake. Forged crowds stop being profitable long before they sway consensus.
